entries.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
entries.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

entries.description: A moving element renders with N ghosted copies of itself at t minus i times delta, opacity stepped down per ghost; one traversal, echoes collapsing into the settled element at rest.

entries.description: The never-fully-lands arrival: an element covers most of its move in the first fifth of the duration and creeps the rest to the last frame, exits along its arrival vector, and carries shutter motion blur — from any side or by scale, one call per element, plus the ease on its own for any tween

entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.description: A small card expands into a full panel, shared-element style: both layouts measured once at mount, the container morphs by transform only (never width/height tweens) while keyed children counter-scale and re-flow onto their own measured targets as pure functions of time.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Morph Swap
entries.description: Two slotted siblings stacked at one shared center: A holds, then condenses or reshapes into B on a shared 50% 50% transform origin. Condense shrink-fades A exactly as B scales up; reshape morphs the silhouette on scaleX/scaleY, never width or height tweens. Token card defaults render when a slot is left empty.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Morph Text
entries.description: Gooey text morph — cycles through an editable word list using SVG threshold + GSAP-driven blur for a fluid, satisfying transition effect
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Motion Blur
entries.description: After Effects-style motion blur — integrates each element over a shutter window (shutter angle, phase, samples per frame) by sampling the GSAP timeline at sub-frame times and averaging equal-weight additive copies of the element along its real trajectory, so translation, scale, rotation, 3D rotation and skew all drive the smear
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Multi Device Splay
entries.description: Phone, tablet, and desktop product mockups fan from a centered stack into a proud splayed arrangement with a subtle idle float.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Multiplayer Cursors
entries.description: Labeled collaborator cursors with token-derived colors and soft glows drift from spread positions into a shared center zone, proving live multiplayer presence.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Native Notification Pop
entries.description: One system-faithful notification banner (iOS or macOS) drops in over any scene on an accurate interruptible spring: fast arrival, soft overshoot, settled mass, backdrop blur, app dot, title, one body line. Holds; tucks away only via exit.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Notes Typing
entries.description: The notes-app confession as a mountable scene: a bold title, then body lines typed character by character on the measured human keystroke rhythm, the caret riding every landed character and jumping down at each paragraph. For a bare prompt line use typed-prompt; for an even mechanical reveal use typewriter
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Notification Pileup
entries.description: Mobile notification cards arrive faster and faster, each new alert pushing the existing stack downward into a dense, anxious tower.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Notification Stack
entries.description: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Number Pop In
entries.description: A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Number Wheel
entries.description: A rolling digit counter primitive for metrics, prices, counts, and scoreboards
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Offset Path Traveler
entries.description: A slotted traveler follows an authored path with tangent rotation, curved entry, and curved exit.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Onboarding Stepper Flow
entries.description: A composed onboarding flow with milestone rail, active step card, and next-action button
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Ordered Dither Pass
entries.description: Bayer-matrix ordered dithering quantizes a slotted scene (rasterized once at mount): the image emerges from pure 2-tone noise to clean, or dissolves the reverse. Stateless per frame, never error diffusion.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Outline Draw
entries.description: A rounded outline that proves a callout by drawing clockwise as a hollow conic-gradient border with a clean closure.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Oversized Cursor
entries.description: The look-here pointer for a video: the macOS arrow at 3.5x its normal size lands its tip on one control, clicks it on, settles just below it so the result stays in view, then exits off-screen
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Overwhelm Surround
entries.description: Tasks, tabs, pings, and notification bubbles accelerate inward around a calm central subject, turning overload into visible spatial pressure.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Page Slide
entries.description: A transitions.dev-inspired page slide primitive with outgoing and incoming panels
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Pan Stations
entries.description: A lateral camera move across a continuous row of labeled feature stations, with a steady dwell at each stop before the next pan.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Panel Reveal
entries.description: A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Paper Collage Reveal
entries.description: A scrapbook patchwork of torn paper scraps, each with its own texture and tilt, flutters away in a staggered scatter to reveal the content underneath.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Parallax Device Dive
entries.description: A canonical phone rises into view before the camera pushes through its screen and layered app UI expands to fill the frame.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Parallax Unzoom
entries.description: Reveal transition — focus card scales down from full frame as siblings parallax in to form a grid (reverse of parallax-zoom)
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Parallax Zoom
entries.description: Center card scales up to fill the frame while siblings parallax outward — inspired by the eBay Playbook hero transition
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Particle Image Reveal
entries.description: A seeded deterministic particle field converges and settles while a slotted image reveals beneath it, the trail thinning until the image holds clean.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Particle Text Dissolve
entries.description: Text assembles from a seeded particle cloud (or dissolves into it): per-particle targets sampled once from the rendered text bitmap at mount, table-driven particles, zero per-particle tweens, one onUpdate painter.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Pendulum Swing
entries.description: Content hangs from a fixed pivot and swings into rest with gravity-damped oscillation, like a hanging sign settling on its hook.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Per-Word Crossfade
entries.description: Words gently fade into place with a short vertical drift for calm keynote rhythm.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Per Word Rise
entries.description: Words or characters rise into place in a controlled blur-to-sharp cascade, settle softly on landing, and hold still until the cut (optional fade or up exit).
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Perspective Marquee
entries.description: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Physical Exit
entries.description: A card exits with physical momentum in toss, drop, or slide mode, carrying acceleration and rotation through the final offscreen pose without fading.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Press Ripple
entries.description: A cursor decel-arrives from off-stage, lands slightly off-center on a caller-positioned target, compresses with it in lockstep, releases with two small click rings while the label swaps to a check, then exits off-stage while the confirmed state holds.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Pull Back Reveal
entries.description: A tight stat detail holds, then one decelerating camera pull-back reveals the headline and supporting cards that recontextualize it.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Pull to Refresh
entries.description: A mobile list pulls through nonlinear rubber-band resistance, arms at a threshold, commits to a bounded loading indicator, then snaps exactly back to rest.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Push In
entries.description: A centered headline gains focus through one slow, continuous camera push and a gentle fade out.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Radial Surround
entries.description: Labeled hairline chips assemble around a centered subject on an elliptical ring, then optionally converge inward with a subtle edge dim. The center never moves: surrounded, not zoomed.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: RGB Glitch Text
entries.description: RGB-offset text copies jitter briefly for a controlled glitch window.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Rubber Band Bumper
entries.description: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Scan Band
entries.description: A diagonal distortion band sweeps once across a clean wordmark, revealing clipped red and cyan offsets only inside the moving band.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Scramble Reveal
entries.description: A deterministic hacker-style text reveal that cycles fixed glyph rows and locks the target string from left to right.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Screen Flow Carousel
entries.description: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Scroll Camera Story
entries.description: A compressed forced-scroll cinematic pass: a tall scene of slotted sections travels past the camera top to bottom, depth layers parallax at different rates, each section rises as the camera reaches it, and the pass decelerates into a held final section.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Scroll Feed
entries.description: A loop-friendly column of varied skeleton post cards scrolls upward with subtle motion trails and an agitated pace.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Segmentation Flood
entries.description: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Separator
entries.description: A one-pixel structural separator with horizontal and vertical variants plus a seek-safe progress reveal
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Settings Toggle Flow
entries.description: A composed settings flow with preference rows, toggle switches, and active-state feedback
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Shared Axis Y
entries.description: Per-word vertical shared-axis transition for sharp editorial swaps.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Shared Axis Z
entries.description: Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Sheet Spring-Up
entries.description: A bottom sheet rushes up from below the frame on a real spring sampled frame by frame from reference footage, overshooting its resting place and settling back without an approximated ease
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Shimmer Sweep
entries.description: Animated light sweep across text or elements using a CSS gradient mask — ideal for AI accents and premium reveals
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Shutter Slam
entries.description: One word thrown through six single-property beats under integrated shutter blur — two translate slams, a scale punch, then a full turn about each axis — on the measured easing of the After Effects export the shutter model was fitted to
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Signup Flow
entries.description: A composed signup flow with social action, email field, password field, and submit button
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Skeleton Reveal
entries.description: A skeleton loader transition that pulses, then cross-fades into content
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Slit Scan Reveal
entries.description: The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Slot Machine Roll
entries.description: A vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Social Proof Card
entries.description: The app-store close as one mountable scene: wordmark, five stars, a proof line, three feature icons and a CTA capsule build in a quiet stagger and hold - measured from reference ad footage. For an animated star sweep use star-rating-fill; for a quote card use testimonial-proof-card; for a bare lockup use cta-lockup
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Soft Blob Touch
entries.description: A granular soft blob idles with slow internal drift; a scripted touch dot decel-arrives, the blob deforms toward it with an attraction bulge, then recovers with a velocity-preserving spring. No hard edges anywhere.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Soft Blur In
entries.description: A soft opacity, blur, and lift reveal for headlines, captions, and product UI callouts
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Split Tilt Cards
entries.description: Two equal-weight cards arrive from opposite wings with mirrored rotateY book-open tilts under one shared perspective, pill badges spring-pop at each inner edge, and the pair holds with a barely-there phase-opposed idle float. Card bodies are content slots with token skeleton defaults.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Spotlight Card
entries.description: A card with a scripted cursor spotlight and lit border.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Spring Pop
entries.description: A badge pops in from a visible near-rest scale, overshoots full size once, and settles cleanly.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Spring Stack Shuffle
entries.description: A stack of 3 to 5 slotted cards reshuffles on cues: the back card throws over the top and lands at the front with real mass, the rest compress and resettle; cues that land mid-flight redirect the moving cards with velocity preserved.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Stagger Cascade
entries.description: A responsive grid of tile cards that fades and travels into place with an evenly spaced per-item GSAP stagger. The ordered cascade is the only visual mechanic.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Stagger Lattice
entries.description: A staggered grid reveal inspired by Anime.js v4 stagger utilities, implemented with GSAP for HyperFrames.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Staggered Fade Up
entries.description: Words fade in and slide up one after another with configurable delay.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Star Rating Fill
entries.description: A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: State Chip Rail
entries.description: A rail of mono status chips advances a seek-safe data-state snap machine on a cue schedule: active chip ink on surface, done chips dim, pending chips hollow, optional badges pop beside one state.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Sticky Mock Swap
entries.description: A pinned product mock cross-fades through accent-tinted feature states while matching captions rise, hold, and exit beside it.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Stitched Text Draw
entries.description: Text drawn as thread stitches: a single-stroke display alphabet draws via attribute-driven dashoffset with stitch-tuned dash patterns, seeded angle jitter, needle-hole dots, a leading needle, and a thread-tail overshoot per letter.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Stop Motion Cadence
entries.description: The stepped-time law as a demo primitive: one driver quantizes timeline time to floor(t * fps) / fps and feeds ALL motion; four token paper-cut shapes throw-and-land with squash on hits, 2-frame boil jitter seeded per step, and sparkle accents living exactly 2 to 3 frames.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Store Badge Lockup
entries.description: Settles a short headline above equal-size App Store and Google Play badges as a token-driven mobile end-card call to action.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Streaming Text
entries.description: Words arrive the way an AI answer streams - in uneven bursts on a measured token rhythm, each word landing grey and inking to full colour - rather than the even tick of a typewriter
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Strikethrough Replace
entries.description: Draw a strike line across old text, then reveal the replacement.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Success Check
entries.description: A success check primitive with ring pop, path draw, and subtle rotate blur
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: SVG Line Draw Loader
entries.description: An Anime.js-style path drawing loader implemented as a seekable GSAP stroke timeline.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: SVG Mask Reveal
entries.description: A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: SVG Stroke Trace
entries.description: An authored SVG path draws from its measured length, holds with subtle drift, and optionally fills when the path is closed.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Swipe Rail
entries.description: A contact circle leads a horizontal card rail through a fast drag, momentum carry, and settled snap to the next card.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Tabs Slide Indicator
entries.description: A pill indicator transition that slides between active tabs
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Telemetry HUD
entries.description: Quiet mono debug-HUD readouts frame a slotted subject: corner brackets draw on, label:value lines tick their values on cues, one readout emphasized in accent. The subject never moves; the HUD breathes zero.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Terminal Simulator
entries.description: A terminal window types commands and streams log output.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Testimonial Card
entries.description: Reveals a customer quote at reading pace, then settles its avatar, author name, and handle beneath as a clean proof beat.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Testimonial Proof Card
entries.description: A quote card whose testimonial reveals per-line through a soft mask, with an avatar disc (initials default, image slot), mono name and role, an optional company text mark, and one emphasis substring underlined in accent ink after the quote lands.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Text Match Cut
entries.description: One line of text becomes another mid-move: both ride a single 85 % easy-ease curve and hard-swap at the speed peak, as scale, tracking, or a same-direction slide.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Text Shimmer
entries.description: A static headline receives one clean specular gradient sweep through its glyphs, then returns to its ordinary text color.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Text Stagger
entries.description: A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Text State Swap
entries.description: A text state swap primitive with outgoing blur and incoming lift
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Texture Mask Text
entries.description: CSS luminance masks that cut holes through letterforms - 66 pre-built texture masks from ambientCG PBR color maps
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Three Orbiting Cards
entries.description: A Three.js-powered orbit scene driven by a paused GSAP timeline for deterministic renders.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Ticker Takeover
entries.description: A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Tilt Card
entries.description: A transitions.dev-inspired tilt card primitive with depth layers and hover-style parallax
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Titlecard Calm
entries.description: A restrained title card where a mono kicker and generous grotesque headline fade upward, drift almost imperceptibly, and exit cleanly.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Titlecard Lockup
entries.description: The calm breather titlecard: an optional mono kicker fades up, the wordmark settles dead-center with one restrained move, a hairline rule draws left to right, a mono label fades beneath, and the lockup holds truly still.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Toggle Flip
entries.description: An oversized UI toggle switch that flips with real physicality: thumb overshoot, track color crossfade, and a soft press-compress before release. The reference prop of the ui-props family.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Top-Down Letters
entries.description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Torn Paper Rip
entries.description: A fibrous paper tear runs across the frame: the torn sheet shows its white paper core along the edge and lifts away on a soft shadow, leaving the next scene standing.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Touch Indicator
entries.description: A translucent contact-circle gesture actor for mobile UI scenes: it touches the glass on the frame the host target responds, then lifts. Tap or swipe, picked by variable.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Tracing Beam
entries.description: A glowing dash follows one SVG path through three UI elements, lifting and brightening each element in sequence.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Tracking In
entries.description: A precise letter-spacing reveal for premium headings and interface labels
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Trust Strip
entries.description: A monochrome trust row of wide-tracked mono wordmarks that fade in with an opacity-only left-to-right stagger, then hold dead still.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Type Match Cut
entries.description: A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Typed Prompt
entries.description: A prompt line types itself in chunked human cadence behind a deterministic blinking caret, with optional backspace-and-retype correction of the final word.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Typewriter
entries.description: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Typing Indicator
entries.description: The three-dot chat bubble that says someone is writing: it pops in at the thread's edge exactly as messaging apps do, holds while the reply is coming, and vanishes when the message lands
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: UI Focus Zoom
entries.description: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Variable Axis Type
entries.description: A locked one-line headline whose weight or width axis morphs into a decisive emphasis beat.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Variable Font Flex
entries.description: A word lands while its variable-font weight and width axes flex from hairline-condensed to black-wide with per-character stagger; font-size eases inversely so the letterforms gain mass while the box holds.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Vector Editor Rig
entries.description: A dark design-tool app chrome with a live vector pen path, sequential anchor points, bezier handles, a selection frame, and theme-driven blue accents.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Velocity Throw Snap
entries.description: A five-shot rail whips past on a fast decaying curve, then overshoots and snaps the selected hero shot exactly to center.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Vignette
entries.description: Cinematic radial vignette overlay using a pure-CSS gradient — darkens the edges to pull focus toward the center
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Vox Annotate
entries.description: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Whip Pan Cut
entries.description: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Whiteboard Ink
entries.description: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Wordmark Tiles
entries.description: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: X Follow Card
entries.description: A social follow card with avatar, handle, and follower motion.
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Camera Punch-In
entries.description: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Pointer Circle + Countdown
entries.description: Draw-on annotation ellipse around a target plus a countdown chip that pulses each tick
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Feathered Spotlight
entries.description: Dims the frame except a feathered ellipse; the hole's position and size are CSS variables, so helpers glide the spotlight between targets
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: On-Screen Display Effect
entries.description: Grid, scanline, vignette, and sheen overlay plus a 3D-warp wrapper class that makes footage read as if playing on a physical display
entries.author: Hyperframes

entries.title: Zoom Through Transition
entries.description: A transition that zooms through a focal card into the next scene.
